description: Curated ARM64 installation media for Surface Pro 11. Entries with implemented support have runnable image adapters; entries also marked experimental still require complete end-to-end boot and installation testing.

entries.name: Debian 13.6.0 DVD 1
compatibility_notes: No lexr image adapter is implemented yet.
The versioned release URL and publisher checksum pin the upstream bytes.
Complete end-to-end testing is still required for this image, especially to confirm its image structure and bootability.

entries.name: elementary OS 8.1 ARM64
compatibility_notes: No lexr image adapter is implemented yet.
The publisher generates a new epoch-tokenised URL on each page request; this stored URL was live on 2026-08-30.
Complete end-to-end testing is still required for this image, especially to confirm its image structure and bootability.

entries.name: Fedora Workstation 44 Raw Disk Image
compatibility_notes: No lexr image adapter is implemented yet.
This is a compressed raw disk image, not an ISO, and requires a raw-image-specific workflow.
Complete end-to-end testing is still required for this image, especially to confirm its image structure and bootability.

entries.name: Fedora Workstation Live 44
compatibility_notes: The experimental Fedora Live adapter can create and structurally validate a remastered image; this does not establish hardware bootability.
A generated Fedora 44 image passed structural validation and USB read-back verification, but a Surface Pro 11 boot reached the emergency path and then remained at a black screen.
Complete end-to-end testing is still required for this image, especially to confirm its image structure and bootability.

entries.name: Pop!_OS 24.04 ARM64 Generic 3
compatibility_notes: No lexr image adapter is implemented yet.
Surface Pro 11 boot and device-tree integration have not yet been automated for this image.
Complete end-to-end testing is still required for this image, especially to confirm its image structure and bootability.

entries.name: Ubuntu Concept Resolute Desktop for X1E (2026-03-26)
compatibility_notes: The experimental Ubuntu Casper adapter can create and structurally validate a remastered image; this does not establish hardware bootability.

On 2026-09-05, physical testing of the 2026-03-26 source remastered with Lexr 384f2c0 and kernel 7.2.0-jg-0sp11v23-qcom-x1e reached the live desktop on Surface Pro 11 X1E/OLED; the tester confirmed Wi-Fi connected without a live-session repair. Ubuntu live-boot evidence is tracked in https://github.com/ooaklee/lexr.sh/issues/41.

Installation, installed-system boot and the full peripheral matrix remain unqualified under https://github.com/ooaklee/lexr.sh/issues/16; the X1E/OLED result does not qualify X1P/LCD or other kernel versions.
Canonical does not publish a checksum alongside this snapshot; use --source-sha256 to pin independently verified bytes.
Complete end-to-end testing is still required for this image, especially to confirm its image structure and bootability.
